ingredients.title: miso brown butter
items: 250 gram (20 oz) short pasta, shells or orecchiette
1 teaspoon crushed chili flakes, extra for serving
1/2 teaspoon each: cumin, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, cayenne pepper

steps: Step 1Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain, reserving 1/4 cup of the cooking water.

Step 2For the breadcrumbs. Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil. Once hot, add panko and walnuts, cook, stirring for 4 minutes until toasted and golden. Add chopped sage and cook for 1-2 minutes more. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from the skillet to a plate.

Step 3Heat the same skillet over medium heat, add butter. Lower the heat and cook for 2-3 minutes or until butter foams and starts to brown. Add garlic and olive oil, cook for 2 minutes until soft. Stir in miso, lower the heat to minimum trying not to burn miso or garlic. Add chili flakes, sage leaves and the seasoning.
Step 4Toss with pasta and add the reserved cooking water. Now taste and add salt and pepper. Serve immediately with crunchy breadcrumbs, pecorino and some extra chili flakes. Enjoy!
